lines.text: Good morning! Did you finish reading that chapter on productivity systems?
I did, actually. The section on time blocking was really interesting.
Right? I've been trying to implement it this week. It's harder than it sounds.
The trick is to start with just two or three blocks per day. Don't try to schedule everything at once.
That makes sense. I kept overloading my calendar and then ignoring it completely.
Exactly. Small consistent habits beat ambitious plans every time.
